We have presented our analyses and a new dataset of 102 papers annotated with nine attributes to ascertain the different metrics, used currently by authors in NLG across publications in 2023 in both INLG and ACL venues.
A total of 98 papers (94.23%) used automatic metrics, a result similar to what was found by van der Lee et al. ( ), who reported 95% of papers using automatic metrics in both ACL tracks and INLG.
